about: Shared cases for the uncertainty gate. tests/test_uncertainty_gate.py runs them through the server (interview_coverage.uncertain_wording, server.validate_findings, the dimension gate) and tests/test_uncertainty_gate.cjs runs them through the browser's copy in web/app.js. 'confident' rows are fully stated process facts that must stay captured; 'uncertain' rows must be held at partial, and their third value is the exact wording the gate reports. Together they are the corpus: every sentence the audit (server-validation-1, agent-team-coverage-8), the reviews of the fix and its follow-ups (r1-gate-1, r1-gate-2, r1-gate-3) name, each with its topic and its decision. 'held_by_cost' lists the 'uncertain' rows that a reader may take for a plain process fact, with the reason they are held: a wrong hold costs one turn (the lead is told the wording and can ask or reword), a wrong pass lets an interview complete on a hedged fact. Sentences written after the rules were final are in uncertainty_gate_heldout.json.
